title: Ibu nke Akụnụba
intro: Ị na-eguzo n'ihu akụkọ banyere nnukwu akụnụba, ndụ e ji ọlaedo na ike chọọ mma, ma n'ikpeazụ ihe mmụta ịdọ aka ná ntị nye ndị niile na-achọ ịdị ebube ụwa. Ị nwere ike ịkọwa njirimara nke onye a bụ onye akụkọ ya na-ada ụda n'oge, ihe akaebe nke ọdịdị ihe onwunwe ụwa na-adịghị agwụ agwụ?
clues: E si m n'etiti ndị nke onye amụma ukwu, mana ahọpụtara m ụzọ mpako na mmegbu.
Allah nyere m nnukwu akụnụba, nke mere na mkpịsị ugodi nke akụ m bụ ibu arọ nye otu ìgwè mmadụ siri ike.
Ndị m gwara m ka m ghara inwe obi ụtọ n'akụnụba m, na-echetara m na Allah ahụghị ndị na-enwe obi ụtọ n'anya.
Eji m mpako kwuo na nnukwu akụnụba m bụ n'ihi ihe ọmụma na mgbalị m, ọ bụghị ngọzi sitere n'aka Allah.
A dọrọ m aka ná ntị megide nrụrụ aka ma chetara m ka m jiri ihe Allah nyere m chọọ Ndụ Mgbe A Ga-ebi, mana ekweghị m ige ntị wee nọgide na-anya isi.
N'ikpeazụ, Allah mere ka ụwa loda m na ebe obibi m, wee hapụ m enweghị onye enyemaka megide iwu Ya.

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A zọpụtara ya site na mbibi

verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
